method: Per-card original illustration comparison, enlarged details, final normal-size and full-resolution render inspection. Unclear/obscured detail remains explicitly limited.

cards.finding: Nappa's shouting mouth, side gaze, both fists and segmented shoulder armor remain. Original head/arm edge crops and the dark backdrop are retained; the watermark obscures some left-side detail.
Yajirobe retains puffed cheeks, sideways pupils, food in one hand and the red bag in the other, with orange striped clothing and blue wristbands. Fine bag lettering is a stylized reconstruction.

Tien's small closed smile, three eyes, white sleeveless shirt and green wristbands remain. Chiaotzu keeps the wide-eyed worried expression, hat, green/yellow clothing and visible hand; the partial turban at left remains.
Seated Yajirobe keeps closed eyes, the small open chewing mouth, bag, both hands, crossed legs and detached sandals. The dark blue/purple backdrop and cushion retain depth.

Piccolo retains the tight tilted close-up, clenched teeth, open eyes, antennae and sweat. The inherited forehead crop is recorded; the long title is reduced proportionally within the new 620-unit safe width.
Yajirobe's squeezed eyes, grimacing teeth and both hands gripping the rock remain. Finger overlaps and the close rock/face framing were enlarged and inspected.
Piccolo keeps the tense teeth, downward gaze, sweat, antennae and foreshortened reaching hand. The source's top-of-head crop remains; cloud and blue-sky placement are retained.
Piccolo retains the side-profile eye, clenched teeth, sweat and pink shoulder segment against horizontal speed lines. No hidden facial detail is inferred.
Krillin keeps the concentrated closed mouth, raised brows, forward fist and partial opposite hand. The forehead edge crop and orange/blue costume remain.
Krillin's sideways look, closed mouth, clenched fist, bent leg, turtle chest mark and wristbands remain. The courtyard wall, trees and distant tower retain their arrangement.
Shenron retains the compact intertwined coil, raised head, open mouth and tongue against yellow clouded sky. Small scale details remain stylized rather than scan-identical.
Chi-Chi retains wide eyes, a small open mouth, high hair, purple dress and orange scarf/sash. The braced hand and kitchen doorway, cooker, utensils and chairs remain visible.
Goku and Raditz retain the crossing arm action, clenched expressions, bare hands, orange/blue gi and brown/black armor. Both foreground arm chains were followed to their respective bodies.
Chi-Chi's surprised open mouth, eyes, hair and orange/purple clothing remain opposite Roshi's back view. Enlarged review confirms the shape by Roshi's glasses is his ear, not a missing hand.
Raditz retains the alarmed open mouth, wide visible eye, green scouter, armor and foreground blast. The eye under the scouter and anatomy hidden by the blast are unresolved.
Raditz's narrow visible eye and tooth-showing smirk remain behind the raised fist, with the green scouter and close framing intact. Hidden eye detail is not certified.
Raditz and Goku retain the close body impact, overlapping hair/torso, orange clothing, boot and armor. The obscured Goku face and exact hidden limb details remain unresolved.

Shirtless Goku retains the low viewpoint, raised open hands, head tipped back, torn orange trousers and blue belt. The sky/cloud arrangement remains; the upturned face is too obscured for an exact expression pass.
Raditz keeps the restrained closed-mouth smirk, green scouter, red upper-arm band and shoulder armor. The standing pose and blue sky remain.
The tight diagonal Raditz action crop retains the raised arm, torso armor, visible eye and clenched teeth. Features beyond the source edges remain unavailable.
Raditz retains the side-profile shout, wide eye, swept hair, segmented shoulder pad and horizontal motion lines against blue sky.
Roshi, Bulma, Puar and Oolong retain their positions and surprised expressions in the pink interior. Clothing, glasses, beard and Bulma's red bow remain; tiny original facial details are limited.

Goku retains the upward gaze, tense teeth, orange gi, blue undershirt, belt and turtle chest insignia. Full-size and pixel comparison confirm the emblem was already present; no artwork repair was needed.
Flying Piccolo retains the clenched teeth, forward-reaching arm, purple clothing and pink arm segments. The diagonal pose and blue sky/clouds remain.
Raditz retains the forward fist, restrained smile, scouter, armor and original side angle. Fingertips and arm/shoulder connection were inspected; the covered eye is unresolved.
Goku retains the over-shoulder look, tense teeth, bare shoulder and close foreshortening. Hair and blue backdrop remain unchanged.
Raditz retains the eye peering over the foreground arm, far raised fist and speed lines. The mouth is obscured and is not treated as verified.
Raditz retains the clenched teeth and turned head beneath the incoming arm, with scouter, armor and the red lower-left action shape intact. Hidden hand detail is unresolved.
Prone Goku retains the strained face, outstretched foreground hand, bare torso, torn orange trousers and both boots. The enclosing rocks and terrain remain.
The scouter close-up retains the eye behind the green lens, yellow character silhouette and display marks. Exact tiny fictional display lettering is not claimed scan-identical.
Piccolo retains the open shouting mouth, intense eyes, sweat and foreshortened segmented arms. The energy blast and purple motion lines remain; watermark-obscured original detail is limited.
Raditz retains his frontal stance, fists, green scouter and armor between Piccolo and Goku. Boots, mountain scenery and foreground arms remain visible; the tiny original faces are unresolved.

The retained approved Kaio-Ken illustration keeps the crouch, clenched fists, toothy expression, torn red costume and magenta aura. Full retained source height is fitted; inherited hair/boot cuts differ from the more complete printed scene and are recorded as a source limitation.
Piccolo's diagonal close-up retains the open fanged mouth, turban and bright eye beam. Pupils and anatomy beneath the beam remain obscured.
Piccolo retains the tense toothy expression, cape/turban, rear fist and glowing foreground fist. The source's tight turban framing and dark directional background remain.

Goku retains the closed mouth, sideways gaze, hanging foreground hand and small pink fragment at upper left. The close head/side crop remains. The Ally-banishment cost precedes the block icon and effect.
Shenron retains the red-eye extreme close-up, folded green brow and directional shading. Hands and limbs are not applicable; the deck limit remains before the activated power.

The approved current Goku source keeps the crouch, bare upper arms, black belt, serious closed mouth and both open hands. Hair/hands clear the stages; mountain and cloud scenery remain. Level, PUR and all eleven values were checked against the printed card.

The corrected overhead forward-leaning Goku pose remains, with closed serious mouth, swept hair, orange/blue gi and lowered arms. Pink sky/yellow field and the inherited lower-hand crop remain; Level/PUR/stages match the original.

The corrected shirtless crouching Goku retains both fists, narrowed eyes, gritted teeth and both boots. Character placement clears the stages; rocky scenery remains. Level/PUR/stages and activated damage reduction were checked.
Piccolo retains the frontal turban/cape pose, pursed mouth and palm leaves at upper left. Face/torso remain left of the stage column; cape asymmetry and all game values are retained.

The approved localized upturned-mouth correction remains. Piccolo's head tilt, opposite-shoulder grip, segmented arms, purple clothing and blue tonal background were inspected; all stage/Level/PUR values match the original.

Piccolo retains the wide stance, both boots, energy ball near the face, yellow ring and icy landscape. The face is partly obscured by energy, so hidden mouth detail remains unresolved. Both hands/feet clear the stages; the attack/defense alternative uses one sword icon.

Gohan retains the forward lean, clenched teeth, yellow/green outfit, family emblem, tail and visible hands/feet. Original mountains remain; no infinity or shield is added to the once-per-Combat trigger. Level/PUR/stages were checked.

Gohan retains the crouch, closed determined mouth, raised fist, sword/strap, torn orange trousers and boots. The incorrect chest glyph is replaced only within the badge with the original Saiyan-training demon emblem; all surrounding artwork is protected. The usage restriction precedes the attack icon; Level/PUR/stages were checked.

localized_costume_correction.description: Restore original Saiyan-training demon chest emblem; source illustration retained beneath a localized patch.
localized_costume_correction.method: Built-in image generation; only the clipped badge patch is used.

cards.finding: Gohan retains the airborne pose, wide eyes, open mouth, extended arms, torn knees and boots against the purple cliff/yellow sky. The missing round demon chest badge is restored with a localized patch; face, hands, clothing and scenery outside it remain protected. Level/PUR/stages were checked.

localized_costume_correction.description: Restore original Saiyan-training demon chest emblem; source illustration retained beneath a localized patch.
localized_costume_correction.method: Built-in image generation; only the clipped badge patch is used.

cards.finding: Krillin retains the raised fist supported by the other hand, concentrated closed mouth, orange gi and blue wristbands. Full head and both hands clear the stage column; Level/PUR/stages match the printed card.

Krillin retains the raised knee, foreground fist, open mouth, opposite arm, orange/blue costume and directional motion background. The complete retained source height remains fitted and hands clear the stages; game values match the original.

Krillin retains the crouch, two open hands, closed serious mouth, turtle emblem and tiled courtyard. Source-visible fingers and body placement remain left of the stages; the activated recycle power has no constant icon.

Raditz retains the foreshortened reaching hand, visible eye, scouter, hair and segmented armor against purple. Face detail behind the hand/scouter remains unresolved. Villain red, Level/PUR/stages and the CRD's reduction to 2 life cards are preserved without a shield.
